rows.title: Amend goes through a confirmation page, then opens the amend review, in animals and plants
rows.detail: A trader who amends a submitted notification is asked to confirm first, on a page of its own, and then lands straight on that notification's review page, where every answer and its Change link sit together. Today Amend on a notification's card starts the amendment at once, and the plants journey does the same; a notification's view page offers Amend as a button that posts and starts the amendment with no confirmation. After this change one confirmation page stands in front of every way into an amendment: 'Amend this notification' on the view page and Amend on the card both open it, confirming is a form post that starts the amendment and lands on the review, and backing out leaves the notification submitted and untouched. An amendment that cannot start, because the reference is unknown, the notification has been deleted or it is not submitted, changes nothing and returns the trader to the set's own notification list. The plants journey gets the same page and lands on its own review page. The performance suite's amendment journey follows the new landing.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Amend this notification' on a submitted notification's view page, and Amend on its card in the set's notification list, open a page whose title and level-1 heading are 'Amend notification' and which asks 'Are you sure you want to change this notification?', and the notification still shows as submitted until the trader confirms (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-046, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-047, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-051; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-107, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-108; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-181, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-055; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-078)

'Amend this notification' on the view page is a link that opens the amend confirmation page and leaves the notification submitted with nothing changed; 'Copy as new' on the same header posts a form of its own, 'Delete' is a link to the delete confirmation page, and no action sits inside another action's form (ruling:sam-2026-11-19 ruling-sam-2026-11-19-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-11-19-p1-007, ruling-sam-2026-11-19-p1-033; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-078)

'Yes, continue' on the amend confirmation page is a button that submits the page's form and starts the amendment, and the trader lands on that notification's review page showing it is being amended (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-048; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-110; repo:tests repo-tests-p6-002, repo-tests-p6-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-121; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-034)

'No, go back' on the amend confirmation page is a link-styled control that returns to the notification's view page with the notification still submitted and nothing changed, and the page's Back link goes to the view page too (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-048; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-110; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-058; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-079)

With JavaScript turned off, choosing Amend on the view page or on the card opens the amend confirmation page, and its 'Yes, continue' still starts the amendment (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-076; ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-021, ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-023)

Opening or posting a notification's amend address when its reference is unknown, when the notification has since been deleted, or when it is a draft or one already being amended, changes nothing and returns the trader, with no message, to the set's own notification list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-075; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-129; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-092, repo-backend-p2-093; repo:tests repo-tests-p6-005, repo-tests-p6-006; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-102)

In the high-risk plants frontend, Amend on a submitted plants notification's card and on its view page open the same confirmation page, with the same title, heading, question, 'Yes, continue' and 'No, go back'; 'Yes, continue' lands on plants' own review page for that notification, and a refused amend returns to plants' own notification list with no message (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-108; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-058)

On the workspace stack the performance suite's amendment journey passes with Amend landing on the notification's amend review: its amendment-started check expects the review page, it still edits the origin page, and both its endings still pass, either cancelling at the cancel-amendment page to land on the view page whose address carries ?cancelled=1, or resubmitting through the review and the declaration (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-071, repo-perftests-p1-072, repo-perftests-p1-074; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-002)

With the service in Welsh, the amend confirmation page's title, heading, question and controls show Welsh text of the same shape, in animals and in plants (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-130; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-110)
rows.gate: Look at the amend confirmation page in animals and plants, and the view header's Amend now a link to it: the cancel-amendment page and the germinal set's copy follow the same page pattern, and the header's link-or-form choice is copied by every later header action.
openQuestions: Once the amend confirmation page exists, is 'Amend this notification' on the notification view header a link to that page, or a posting button in its own form? Default, which this row builds: a link to the notification's amend confirmation page, because nothing changes until the trader confirms, exactly as Delete opens the delete confirmation page; Copy as new keeps a form of its own, Delete stays a link, and no action shares another action's form, in live animals, germinal products and plants alike.
rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the confirmation page (req-1391, req-1392), the guard (req-1487) and the performance-suite check (req-1877): one route, one page, one review and one ladder. c-190 and c-310 settle that the confirmation is a page carrying the pop-up's wording and that the card's Amend goes through it; c-189 that confirming is a form post; c-191 and c-225 that the landing is the review and the k6 check moves with it; c-198 that a refused amend goes to the set's own list. req-1394, where confirming lands, left this row's requirements this re-distil because it is now adopted as already met: the frontend already redirects to the review page, so the landing is stated only as part of what 'Yes, continue' does. c-438 is new and open; its default makes the view header's Amend a link, so the row builds that and says so. The dialog half of req-1391 and req-1392 is req-1393's, which is out of scope. The view page header is overview-and-review's code, so that row must have landed; the card's Amend lives in each frontend's dashboard feature, which the animals-dashboard theme also changes.

rows.title: The cancel-amendment page is one question and two controls, and returns to the submitted notification with no banner, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Cancelling an amendment is confirmed on a short page: a question as its heading, no explanation, a button to confirm and a plain link back. Today the page asks 'Cancel this amendment?', explains that the changes will be discarded, offers a secondary button back to the notification, and carries the notification's status tag, reference and a Back link above the heading; the restored notification then opens with a success banner. After this change the page carries the question and its two controls alone, the restored notification's view shows no banner although its address still marks the cancellation, and opening the page for a notification nobody is amending returns the trader to the set's own notification list. Plants' cancel-amendment page changes the same way in the same increment.
acceptanceCriteria: The cancel-amendment page's title and level-1 heading are 'Are you sure you want to cancel this amendment?', with no caption above the heading (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-027, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-052; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-125; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-083, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-080)

The whole content of the cancel-amendment page is its heading, the button 'Yes, cancel amendment' and a link-styled 'Go back' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-054, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-080)

'Go back' returns the trader to the notification's view, which is the amend review while an amendment is in progress, and leaves the amendment and its changed answers in place (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-029, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-054; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-110, repo-frontend-p7-111; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-084)

'Cancel amend' beside Continue on the amend review, 'Cancel amend' in the amend status bar and 'Cancel amendment' on the notification's card all reach the page at the notification's own cancel-amendment address, which shows its heading as the first thing under the service header, with no status tag, reference or Back link above it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-056; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-106, repo-frontend-p7-112, repo-frontend-p7-123; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-084, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-091; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-086)

After 'Yes, cancel amendment' the trader lands on the notification's view page, read only and showing it submitted with its submitted answers, its address carrying ?cancelled=1 and no banner above the page heading (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-094, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-095-m1; repo:tests repo-tests-p6-040, repo-tests-p6-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-088)

Opening the cancel-amendment address, or posting to it, for a notification that is not being amended, a submitted one included, changes nothing and returns the trader, with no message, to the set's own notification list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-085; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-128; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-114, repo-frontend-p7-115, repo-frontend-p7-120; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-102)

In the high-risk plants frontend the cancel-amendment page has the same title and heading, the same two controls and nothing else, with 'Go back' returning to plants' check answers view; after 'Yes, cancel amendment' plants' view shows the restored submitted notification with no banner and its address carries ?cancelled=1; and opening or posting it for a plants notification that is not being amended returns to plants' own notification list with no message (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-086, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-087, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-088, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-092, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-093, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-094; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-059)

With the service in Welsh, the cancel-amendment page's heading, 'Yes, cancel amendment' and 'Go back' show Welsh text of the same shape, in animals and in plants (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-130; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-110)
rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the page copy (req-1410, req-1411, req-1413), the page's shape and how it is reached (req-1414), where confirming lands (req-1416) and the guard (req-1417): one route, one confirmation, reviewed once. c-190 settles that the confirmation stays a page at today's address; c-195 that the wording changes despite the earlier judgement that left these pages unassessed; c-268 that the address keeps ?cancelled=1 while the banner goes; c-198 that the guard lands on the set's own list. 'Cancel amend' beside Continue on the amend review is overview-and-review's code, and the amend status bar's 'Cancel amend' is journey-foundation's; both must have landed. 'Yes, cancel amendment' stays a standard primary button (req-1412, already met). The page's journey strip comes from each frontend's shared kit, which journey-foundation owns: the strip is turned off from this page's own feature, not changed in the kit. The performance suite reads the address and the view page, so it needs no change here. Unchanged in substance by this re-distil.

rows.title: Copy as new carries over the trade answers and clears the shipment answers, from the submitted version
rows.detail: A copy of a notification keeps the answers that describe the trade — the origin, the internal reference number, what is being imported with its species, the main reason for import and its follow-ups, the additional animal details, the parties and the CPH number — and leaves the answers that belong to one shipment to be given again: how many animals and packages, the animal identifiers, the arrival, the transit countries, the transporter, the documents and the contact address. Today the record and the pages disagree: the record clears the internal reference, the species, the unweaned answer and the exit date, while the copy's overview shows counts, identification, arrival, transit, transport and contact address as Complete because the whole answer payload is copied across. After this change a copy keeps and clears the same list in the record and on the pages alike, and copying a notification part-way through an amendment copies its submitted version rather than the edits in progress. The plants journey has no copy action, so plants does not change.
acceptanceCriteria: A copy's origin of the import comes back with the source notification's internal reference number, and the copy's review page shows it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-063; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-048; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-078)

A copy's commodity pages come back with the source's commodity, its commodity selections and its selected species, and the copy carries the same notification type, worked out from the copied answers where it is not stored (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-064, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-071; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-049, repo-backend-p2-050, repo-backend-p2-051; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101)

A copy's import reason pages come back with the main reason for import and its follow-ups: the internal market purpose, the transhipment destination country, the transit port of exit, the transit destination country, and the temporary admission exit date and port of exit (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-065; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-053, repo-backend-p2-059, repo-backend-p2-062; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-003, ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-005; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101)

A copy's additional details come back with what the animals are certified for, whether unweaned animals are included and the storage temperature (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-066; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101)

A copy's overview shows Commodity details as To do, its Animals total reads 0 and its Packages or boxes total shows no figure (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-051; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-102, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-102-m1)

A copy's overview shows Identification details, Arrival details, Transport details and Contact address as To do (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-052, repo-backend-p2-060, repo-backend-p2-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101)
A copy's transit countries page comes back with no country chosen (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p13-109)

Copying a notification that is being amended copies its submitted version: an answer changed during the amendment and not yet resubmitted does not appear on the copy, and the submitted answer does (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-059; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-066)

rows.notes: c-196 settles what a copy carries, in the record and on the pages alike, and c-197 that an amendment in progress is copied from its submitted version. Pass 1 had two slices, what a copy keeps (req-1424, req-1425, req-1428, req-1429) and what it clears (req-1426, req-1427, req-1432 to req-1435); pass 2 merges them with copying the submitted version (req-1437), because each changes the same backend copy mapping and the frontend's stub persistence copy and all are proven by copying one full notification and reading the copy. The copy must clear the cleared answers from the copied answer payload as well as from the record, so the overview's task statuses follow. Rewritten this re-distil to drop the certified-for mapping, which left this row's requirements because req-1430 is now out of scope, and to take the ruled name 'port of exit' for the transit follow-up. What a copy already keeps or clears correctly (req-1423, req-1431, req-1436) stays as it is. The germinal half (req-1880) is the germinal row's. Plants has no copy action (req-2003 and req-2055 are out of scope), so there is no plants half. Copying from the submitted version reads the notification service's copy entry point, which overview-and-review also owns.

rows.title: A stale Copy as new from the view page returns to the view page and says the notification has been updated
rows.detail: Copy as new is checked against the version of the notification the trader was looking at, so a copy of something that has changed since is refused and the trader is told. Started from the notification list this works; started from the notification's view page the trader is sent to an address no page answers. After this change a refused copy returns the trader to where they started, the list or the notification's view page, tells them the notification has been updated, and copies nothing.
acceptanceCriteria: When the notification changed after the trader opened its view page, for instance because it was amended in another tab, Copy as new on that view page copies nothing and returns the trader to the notification's view page showing 'The notification has been updated' (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-068, repo-frontend-p5-070, repo-frontend-p5-071, repo-frontend-p5-072; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-040)

When the notification changed after the trader opened the set's notification list, Copy as new on its card copies nothing and returns the trader to that list showing 'The notification has been updated' (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-070; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-035, repo-backend-p2-040)
After a refused copy, no new draft appears in the set's notification list (repo:backend repo-backend-p2-040, repo-backend-p2-040-m1; repo:tests repo-tests-p6-054, repo-tests-p6-055)
rows.notes: Kept apart from the copy carry-over row: a frontend redirect fix with its own set-up, two tabs and a stale version, and nothing to do with what a copy carries. Plants has no copy action, so there is no plants half. The view page's Copy as new control is overview-and-review's code, which must have landed. Unchanged in substance by this re-distil.

rows.title: The delete confirmation page identifies the notification in a summary, with shorter wording and a plain link back, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Before deleting, the trader is shown which notification they are about to delete — its reference, what is in it, how many and where it came from — and the page's wording and controls are shorter, with a plain link back to the notification. Today the page carries a heading, one sentence and two buttons, shows the notification's status tag and reference above the heading, and its way back goes to the set's notification list. After this change the page shows the summary list, the new sentence, warning and buttons, and both the Back link and the way back return to the notification's view page. Plants' delete page changes in the same increment, filled with plants' own commodity, origin and quantity, and plants' own checks follow it. In the live-animals set the Number row counts animals; the germinal set's packages count is its own increment.
acceptanceCriteria: The delete confirmation page shows a GOV.UK summary list with the rows 'Reference number', 'Commodity', 'Number' and 'Origin', the Origin row giving the notification's country of origin (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-173, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-176; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-138; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-107, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-111)

In the animals sets the Commodity row lists each commodity's common name with its species' Latin names in brackets, comma-separated, such as 'Sheep (Ovis Aries), Goat (Capra Hircus)', and for other live mammals it gives each species' common name (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-174; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-139; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-083)

For a live-animals notification the Number row shows the notification's total number of animals (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-175; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

A summary row the notification has no value for shows what the set's notification list shows for that notification, and 'Not applicable' when the list has nothing either (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-177; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-061)

Below the summary the page says 'Confirm that you want to delete this notification.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-178; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-140; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-108)

The page's red warning button reads 'Yes, delete' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-179; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-109)

The page's button group holds the red warning button 'Yes, delete' and, beside it, a plain link reading 'No, cancel' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-180; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-142; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-110)

The page's Back link and its 'No, cancel' link both return the trader to the notification's view page, and the notification is still there (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-168, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-170, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-171; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-143; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-110)

The page shows its heading as the first thing under the service header, with no status tag or reference above it and no Cancel amend control while the notification is being amended; the summary list is what identifies the notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-171; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-101-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-111)

In the high-risk plants frontend the delete page shows the same four summary rows, filled with the plants notification's reference, its commodity as plants names it, its quantity and its country of origin, the same sentence, warning, 'Yes, delete' and 'No, cancel', no status tag or reference above the heading, and Back and 'No, cancel' both returning to plants' check answers view (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-069, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-070, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-071, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-072, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-074; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-013, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-061)

rows.title: The deletion message reads 'Notification has been deleted' on each set's own list, and the amend, cancel and delete walks are proven end to end
rows.detail: After a delete the trader lands on the set's own notification list, whose address marks the deletion so the list shows the message straight away. The message is worded for a page that does not know the deleted notification's reference, so it names none. Deleting a notification part-way through an amendment already works in the animals journey, but the endpoint's own description says it does not, plants' amending view offers no way to it, and nothing proves it. Nor does anything prove what the amend, cancel-amendment, copy and delete addresses do for a notification that cannot take that action, what a stale amend review does, what cancelling does to a document added during the amendment, or what a deleted notification's own view shows. After this change both the live animals list and plants' own list carry the new message, a notification being amended can be deleted in both journeys, and the end-to-end suite proves each of those walks, keeping its smoke-tagged cancel and delete cases.
acceptanceCriteria: After 'Yes, delete', the live animals notification list, opened at ?deleted=1, shows a success message reading 'Notification has been deleted' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-183; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-145; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101)

In the high-risk plants frontend, plants' own notification list opened at its deleted marker after a delete shows a success message reading 'Notification has been deleted' (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070)

A notification being amended can be deleted from the amend review's Delete button: after 'Yes, delete' it is no longer in the set's notification list, in animals and in plants (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-034; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-094, repo-frontend-p7-095; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-075, repo-plantsfrontend-p11-100; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-118)
The backend's soft-delete endpoint describes itself as deleting draft, submitted and amending notifications (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-034, repo-backend-p3-035)

The end-to-end suite on the workspace stack proves that an amending notification can be deleted, and that amend, cancel amendment, copy as new and delete for a notification that cannot take that action return the trader to the set's own notification list with no message; it still asserts ?cancelled=1 on the cancel-amendment redirect and ?deleted=1 on the delete redirect, and its smoke-tagged cancel-amendment and delete cases still run in the smoke suite against the new wording and landings (repo:tests repo-tests-p6-002, repo-tests-p6-040, repo-tests-p6-041, repo-tests-p6-046 to repo-tests-p6-049, repo-tests-p6-051; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-078)

The end-to-end suite pins the delete page's sentence, its warning and its way back to the notification's view page, and the cancel-amendment page's 'Go back' (repo:tests repo-tests-p6-107, repo-tests-p6-108; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p3-057)

When the notification has changed since the amend review was rendered, Continue on the amend review returns the trader to the amend review showing the notification's current content and submits nothing, and the end-to-end suite proves it (repo:tests repo-tests-p6-109; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p3-058)

Cancelling an amendment during which a document was added returns the notification to the documents it was submitted with, and the end-to-end suite proves it (repo:tests repo-tests-p6-110; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p3-059)

Opening the view page of a notification that has been deleted returns the trader to the set's own notification list with no message, and the end-to-end suite proves it (repo:tests repo-tests-p6-111; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-102)

With the service in Welsh, the deletion message shows Welsh text of the same shape on each set's own list and in plants (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p11-078; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-096)

openQuestions: What does a trader see when they open the view page of a notification that has been deleted? Default, which this row builds: they are returned to the set's own notification list with no message, as every other guard on an action a notification cannot take does.
rows.notes: Draft for merging into inc-126, which already holds req-2032, the plants deletion banner from the notification-list area: the same delete walk proves them, so building them apart would repeat the same set-up, review and ladder. The combiner keeps inc-126's id, its animals-dashboard theme, req-2032 with the notification-list area's own criteria, and the dependencies the row already has on the amend, cancel-amendment and delete page rows. Pass 2 combines the message wording (req-1455), deleting an amending notification with the endpoint's own description (req-1441) and the end-to-end proof (req-1479). c-269 settles where the deletion message shows, now that the address keeps ?deleted=1; c-198 where each guard lands. Rewritten this re-distil because req-1479 now also asks for the delete page's body copy and way back, the cancel page's way-back wording, a stale amend review, a document added during an amendment and a deleted notification's own view: each has its own criterion. req-1479's guard proofs can only be observed once the amend, cancel-amendment and delete page rows have landed. The amend review's Delete button, and plants' amending view control group that must gain it, are overview-and-review's code, so that row must have landed. req-1455's other form, which names the deleted reference, needs a landing page that knows the reference; none does, so it has no criterion. The 'Success' banner title is req-1086's, and req-1881 and req-1882 (the message showing only at the deleted marker, and not dismissing itself) already hold. The germinal list is the germinal row's.

rows.title: Amend, cancel amendment, copy as new and delete for germinal products notifications
rows.detail: A submitted germinal products notification is managed on the germinal set's own copies of the amend, cancel-amendment, notification actions and delete pages, taken from the live-animals ones once this programme has changed them. The germinal delete page counts packages where live animals count animals, and a copy of a germinal notification stays a germinal notification, so it opens in the germinal set and nowhere else.
acceptanceCriteria: A submitted germinal products notification offers Amend, Cancel amendment, Copy as new and Delete through the germinal set's own pages, with the same confirmation pages, wording and destinations as a live-animals notification, and its guards and its delete land on the germinal set's own notification list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

On the germinal products delete page the Number row shows the notification's total number of packages (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-175; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

Copying a germinal products notification makes a germinal products draft with a new reference that opens in the germinal set and not in the live-animals set, and copying a live-animals notification still makes a live-animals draft (repo:backend repo-backend-p2-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-031)

splitOff.why: It changes the amend review's title and level-1 heading. In the animals frontend that heading is built by the check answers view's header view model, and in plants it is the high-risk plants check answers feature; both, and the tests repo's animals notification view page object it is read through, are in the overview-and-review theme's touches. Live animals already switches the heading, so the only work left is plants' own view taking the second heading, which is entirely that theme's code.
